observations: Line 2 uses raw string prefix matching, so '/srv/application/key' starts with '/srv/app' and returns True, violating the stated contract that only root and its descendants are allowed.
Probe p1 is a concrete failing input: permitted('/srv/app', '/srv/application/key') is predicted to return True, an unauthorized path outside root.
Probe p2 is the normal comparison input: permitted('/srv/app', '/srv/app/file') is predicted to return True, which is correct.
The contract excludes trailing slashes, so the boundary case root itself ('/srv/app') is not covered by the probes; prefix matching would return True for it.
No normalization or separator-boundary check (e.g., root + '/') is present, so sibling directories sharing the root prefix are accepted.
static_findings is empty, so no tooling flagged this prefix-match boundary defect.
